section_summary: This final page concludes a supplemental agreement between Japan’s Department of Communications and Mackay Radio and Telegraph Company. It revises provisions on radiotelegraph traffic and rates, preserves the rest of the original agreement, and records its execution in Tokyo on August 21, 1935.
